review.notes: All 18 physical pages compared against the OCR Markdown with a normalized full-text diff plus a whole-document numeric multiset check (residual deltas were the Figure 1 user-study percentages on p.1, printed page numbers and the arXiv stamp). No unbalanced code fences (0 fence blocks); heading tree matches the printed Contents including the Appendix. Reference entries on the reference pages show no dropped lines at single-token granularity. The PDF prints its own typos 'compositon' (p.6), 'betwen' (p.9), 'latentcy' and 'evalute' (p.10); the OCR normalized these four to the standard spellings and they were left unchanged per the printed-typo rule. Pages 1 (three renders: upper half, footnote band, figure) were visually verified; figure-internal labels on p.4, p.5, p.7 and p.8 belong to embedded figure images.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 (250 dpi band, visually read) prints 'Official Page: https://seed.bytedance.com/seed3d_2_0' with plain underscores; the backslash-underscore pairs are Markdown escapes added by OCR, not source text.
